an8.10:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā campāyaṃ viharati gaggarāya pokkharaṇiyā tīre.
an8.10:1.2: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhu bhikkhuṃ āpattiyā codenti.
an8.10:1.3: so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi āpattiyā codiyamāno aññenaññaṃ paṭicarati, bahiddhā kathaṃ apanāmeti, kopañca dosañca appaccayañca pātukaroti.
an8.10:2.6: idha bhikkhave, ekaccassa puggalassa tādisaṃ yeva hoti. abhikkantaṃ paṭikkantaṃ ālokitaṃ vilokitaṃ sammiñjitaṃ pasāritaṃ saṃghāṭipatta cīvaradhāraṇaṃ. seyyathāpi aññesaṃ bhaddakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ
an8.10:2.8: yato ca khvāssa bhikkhu āpattiṃ passanti tamenaṃ evaṃ jānanti.
an8.10:3.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, sampanne yavakaraṇe yavadusī jāyetha, yavapalāpo yavakāraṇḍavo.
an8.10:3.2: tassa tādisaṃyeva mūlaṃ hoti. seyyathāpi aññesaṃ bhaddakānaṃ yavānaṃ,
an8.10:3.3: tādisaṃyeva nālaṃ hoti seyyathāpi aññesaṃ bhaddakānaṃ yavānaṃ,
an8.10:3.4: tādisaṃyeva pattaṃ hoti seyyathāpi aññesaṃ bhaddakānaṃ yavānaṃ,
an8.10:3.6: yato ca khvāssa sīsaṃ nibbattati. tamenaṃ evaṃ jānanti:
an8.10:3.8: tamenaṃ iti viditvā samūlaṃ uppāṭetvā bahiddhā yavakaraṇassa chaḍḍenti.
an8.10:4.1: evameva kho bhikkhave idhekaccassa puggalassa tādisaṃyeva hoti abhikkantaṃ paṭikkantaṃ ālokitaṃ vilokitaṃ sammiñjitaṃ pasāritaṃ saṅghāṭipattacīvaradhāraṇaṃ. seyyathāpi aññesaṃ bhaddakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ
an8.10:4.3: yato ca khvāssa bhikkhū āpattiṃ passanti. tamenaṃ evaṃ jānanti:
an8.10:5.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, mahato dhaññarāsissa pūyamānassa tattha yāni dhaññāni daḷhāni sāravannāni tāni ekamantaṃ puñjaṃ hoti, yāni pana tāni dhaññāni dubbalāni palāpāni tāni vāto ekamantaṃ apakassati.
an8.10:5.2: tamenaṃ sāmikā [apa]sammajjaniṃ gahetvā bhiyyo somattāya apasammajjanti.
an8.10:5.5: evameva kho bhikkhave, idhekaccassa puggalassa tādisaṃyeva hoti abhikkantaṃ paṭikkantaṃ ālokitaṃ vilokitaṃ sammiñjitaṃ pasāritaṃ saṅghāṭipattacīvaradhāraṇaṃ. seyyathāpi nāma aññesaṃ bhaddakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ
an8.10:5.7: yato ca khvāssa bhikkhu āpattiṃ passanti, tamenaṃ evaṃ jānanti;
an8.10:6.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave puriso udapānapaṇāliyā atthiko tiṇhaṃ kuṭhāriṃ ādāya vanaṃ paviseyya,
an8.10:6.2: so taṃ tadeva rukkhaṃ kuṭhāripāsena ākoṭeti. tattha yāni tāni rukkhāni daḷhāni sāravantāni kuṭhāripāsena ākoṭitāni kakkhalaṃ paṭinadanti,
an8.10:6.3: yāni tāni rukkhāni antopūtīni avassutāni kasambujātāni tāni kuṭhāripāsena ākoṭitāni daddaraṃ paṭinadanti.
an8.10:6.4: tamenaṃ mūle chindati, mūle chetvā agge chindati, agge chetvā anto suvisodhitaṃ visodheti, anto suvisodhitaṃ visodhetvā udapānapaṇāliyaṃ yojeti.
an8.10:6.5: evameva kho bhikkhave idhekaccassa puggalassa tādisaṃ yeva hoti abhikkantaṃ paṭikkantaṃ ālokitaṃ vilokitaṃ sammiñjitaṃ pasāritaṃ saṅghāṭipattacīvaradhāraṇaṃ, seyyathāpi nāma aññesaṃ bhaddakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ
an8.10:6.7: yato ca khvāssa bhikkhu āpattiṃ passanti, tamenaṃ evaṃ jānanti:
